integrity: The theorem is proved analytically for all integers n>=1. Exact finite enumeration through n=9 is supplementary verification and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula is for the one-dimensional simple symmetric nearest-neighbor walk, an even deterministic horizon, and strict-positive occupation.
A relevant 1994 Bernoulli-excursion article was available only at abstract level during the literature comparison, leaving a bounded residual historical-literature risk.
title: Finite-lattice covariance between last zero and positive occupation
